snippet.title: Stellaris: Console Edition Season 08 | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Stellaris: Console Edition for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 is available now!

Take one small step into the next generation of Stellaris gameplay, taking full advantage of the advanced hardware and optimization on modern consoles as well as featuring 4k resolution, improved performance, and more galaxy setup options than ever before. Galaxies in Stellaris: Console Edition for Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 really are vast and full of wonders.

Find out more:
https://pdxint.at/43gHnhN

Get it here: https://pdxint.at/3LKWXw4
